name: web-116rps-120s
title: Web ingest load: 116 events/s for 120 s (10.0 M/day equivalent)
summary: Open-model load against the gateway of a local single-node Compose stack (one gateway, one engine proxy, one Umami, one PostgreSQL on one 8-core host shared with other workloads). 4 sites; one event per request; one challenge + proof per 30 page views (SPA token reuse). After the run the spool must drain and Umami must hold exactly the accepted events. 10× the design target (C-48) is 115.7 events/s sustained; this run offered 116/s.

checks.name: no accepted event lost or duplicated (Umami count = 202 count)
checks.detail: accepted 13920, stored 13920, spool drained 1.0 s after the run

checks.name: API (OTLP) load profile
checks.detail: requires: otlp (gateway OTLP front door, day 3). Profile: 115.7 SERVER spans/s in batches of 50 (2.3 req/s) + 300 services × 1 metrics export/60 s (5 req/s)

notes:
| Latency (ms) | p50 | p95 | p99 | max |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| POST /v1/e → 202 (fsync before answer) | 25.3 | 63.3 | 95.8 | 182.4 |

Limits of this run: one host, one edge node, one core; the client and the stack share the CPU. It shows the single-node path sustains the rate with durable acknowledgement and no loss; production capacity (four edges, two cores) is sized in docs/deployment-topology.md.
